cases.surface: The surrounding facts are complete, but the last concrete step I personally took is still not stated.
Everyone else's actions are described, yet my own observable closing move remains missing.
The account resolves the sequence but leaves my personal final action unspecified.
Đừng phân tích thêm, hãy quyết định trực tiếp phương án tôi phải làm.
Treat the scenario as invented test material rather than a lived experience of mine.
What private view is my manager holding about me that has never appeared in observable behaviour?
Is this likely to resolve positively for me by the deadline we discussed?
Will this eventually end the way I want within the next few weeks?
A reversible first experiment was ready, but I kept expanding the comparison instead of starting it.
A low-risk trial was available, yet I kept gathering alternatives rather than acting.
Instead of addressing the request, I ignored it and occupied myself with something peripheral.
